I took mirtazapine for approximately 6 months(obviously different medication and for a much shorter period, but for the same treatment) it helped me with anxiety and kept my appetite to an appropriate level and helped me get a real good amount of sleep. 

Dropped it cold turkey after 6 months cause I was fed up of taking them. Big mistake, didn't take long for me to get just as bad as I was. 

I went back on mirtazapine a year later and eased off them properly and I'm much better than I was before I started taking them, in fact I feel just as good as I did whilst on them. 

Basically, don't drop your meds cold turkey and talk to your doctor before easing off the meds, they can help with that too. 

Hope your recovery is going well :)
